[[Long Beach State 49ers men's basketball|Long Beach State]] (2011–2013) | draft_year = | draft_round = | draft_pick = | draft_team = | career_start = | career_end = | years1 = | team1 = | highlights = *[[Associated Press|AP]] Honorable Mention [[NCAA Men's Basketball All-Americans|All-American]] ([[2013 NCAA Men's Basketball All-Americans|2013]]) *[[Big West Conference Men's Basketball Player of the Year|Big West Player of the Year]] (2013) | stat1label = | stat1value = | stat2label = | stat2value = | stat3label = | stat3value = | letter = | bbr = | HOF_player = | FIBA_HOF_player = }} '''James Ennis''' (born July 1, 1990) is an American basketball player. He was a standout at [[California State University, Long Beach]], where he was an [[NCAA Men's Basketball All-Americans|All-American]] as a senior. Ennis, a 6'7" [[small forward]], played two years at [[Ventura College]], a junior college in [[Ventura, California]]. He then signed with [[Long Beach State 49ers men's basketball|Long Beach State]], where he became a two year starter. As a junior, Ennis averaged 10 [[Points per game|points]] and 4.1 [[rebounds per game]] and helped lead the 49ers to [[Big West Conference]] regular season and conference titles. Ennis was named honorable mention all-conference at the close of the season.{{cite web| last = | first = | title =Big West Unveils 2011-12 Men’s Basketball All-Conference Team | publisher = Big West Conference | date = March 5, 2012 | url =http://www.bigwest.org/sports/mbball/info/review/2011-2012/release2.pdf | accessdate = April 11, 2013}} With the departure of conference player of the year [[Casper Ware]], Ennis became the go to player for the 49ers in [[2012–13 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2012–13]]. He responded by averaging 16.5 points and 6.7 rebounds per game and leading the 49ers to another regular season Big West championship. At the end of the season, Ennis was named [[Big West Conference Men's Basketball Player of the Year|Big West Player of the Year]]{{cite web| last = Bloom | first = Earl | title =Long Beach State picks up Big West honors | publisher = Orange County Register | date = March 11, 2012 | url =http://www.ocregister.com/articles/year-499110-state-team.html | accessdate = April 11, 2013}} and an [[Associated Press|AP]] honorable mention All-American.{{cite web| last = | first = | title =2012-13 AP All-America Teams | publisher = Fox Sports | date = April 1, 2012 | url =http://www.foxnews.com/sports/2013/04/01/2012-13-ap-all-america-teams/ | accessdate = April 11, 2013}} Following the close of his senior year, Ennis was named to the [[Reese's College All-Star Game]], where he led the East team in scoring with 13 points, including a pair of baskets that clinched the game.{{cite web| last = | first = | title = East Tops West 87-81 in Reese's Division I College All-Star Game | publisher = NABC | date = April 5, 2012 | url =http://www.nabc.org/events/2013_Division_I_College_All-Star_Game_wrapup | accessdate = April 11, 2013}} ==References== {{reflist}} ==External links== *[http://www.longbeachstate.com/sports/m-baskbl/mtt/james_ennis_757588.html Long Beach State bio] {{Big West Conference Men's Basketball Player of the Year navbox}} {{Persondata | NAME = Ennis, James | ALTERNATIVE NAMES = | SHORT DESCRIPTION = American basketball player | DATE OF BIRTH = July 1, 1990 | PLACE OF BIRTH = | DATE OF DEATH = | PLACE OF DEATH = }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Ennis, James}} [[Category:1990 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:Basketball players from California]] [[Category:Long Beach State 49ers men's basketball players]] [[Category:Small forwards]] [[Category:Ventura Pirates men's basketball players]]
